articles.headline: Barred Somali World Cup ref 'grateful' for Super Cup shot
articles.description: Omar Artan -- the Somali World Cup referee refused entry to the United States -- has spoken about the "very tough period" during what should have been the highlight of his career.

articles.headline: UEFA, Concacaf, AFC accuse FIFA of 'breach of trust,' 'deception' over World Cup plan
articles.description: UEFA, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) have accused FIFA of a "fundamental breach of trust" over its handling of plans to sell a stake in the World Cup.

articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: There's nothing like a World Cup to put young stars in the shop window! With that in mind, ESPN has assembled a list of all the Socceroos' post-tournament transfers, all in one place.

articles.headline: FIFA hits out at campaign to 'undermine' president Infantino
articles.description: FIFA has hit out at what it called "a concerted and ongoing effort by some to undermine" world soccer's governing body and its president Gianni Infantino.

articles.headline: Gianni Infantino denies UEFA made payment to alleged lover
articles.description: Gianni Infantino has denied that UEFA paid off his alleged lover while he was the organisation's general secretary.
